# Description

What this PR does, in a sentence or two.

## Motivation / why

Why this change is needed. Link the related issue if there is one (e.g. `Closes #12`).

## What changed

Files and areas touched, with a short note on each.

-

## Type of change

- [ ] fix - bug fix
- [ ] feat - new feature
- [ ] docs - documentation only
- [ ] refactor - no behavior change
- [ ] ci - build or workflow
- [ ] test - tests only
- [ ] chore - tooling, deps, housekeeping

> Keep the PR title aligned with Conventional Commits, e.g. `fix: stop dropping all-day events`.

## How tested

How you verified the change. Mention COM vs Graph mode if relevant, and whether
you ran a real sync cycle (`python src/app.py once`).

## Checklist

- [ ] Ran `pytest` and it passes
- [ ] Ran `ruff check` and it is clean
- [ ] No secrets committed (no credentials, tokens, or `config.json`)
- [ ] Updated docs and `config.example.json` if config changed
